def factor_tail_semivar_volsync_ema60_v1(df):
    """Volume-confirmed tail semivariance asymmetry with recent stress weighting."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_weight = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    down_ret = ret.where(ret < 0)
    up_ret = ret.where(ret > 0)
    down_var = (down_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).ewm(span=60, min_periods=20, ignore_na=True).mean()
    up_var = (up_ret ** 2 * vol_weight).ewm(span=60, min_periods=20, ignore_na=True).mean()
    spread = down_var - up_var
    total = down_var + up_var
    factor = spread / total.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_tail_semivar_volsync_ema60_v1"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_tail_semivar_volsync_ema60_v1"]
description: Parent strength target is the bounded [-1,1] downside/upside tail semivariance ratio with bounded volume confirmation and RankICIR stability. The parent bottleneck is the equal-weight 60-day rolling sum, which dilutes recent stress events and may weaken IC/ICIR. This mutation replaces the rolling sum with an exponential moving average (span 60, min periods 20) to give greater weight to recent tail stress while preserving volume weighting [0.5, 2.0] and raw ratio interpretation. No new components are added.
